notes.title: Sneak peek from the current development stage of Fisherman Classic
notes.notes:
https://imgur.com/KiazGYq

That's not much to say. Let's leave some mistery. But, yes, the guy is carrying both a fishing rod AND a handgun. AND there's Dinosaurs. AND there's some splash on the water when you move your little boat. AND, of course, a new and improved hud and fishing system.

notes.title: Fisherman Classic is more alive than ever.
notes.notes:
That's it. Even though it left Early Access, Fisherman Classic is back to development, and V2.0 is getting near. A completely remasterized game, with more places to explore and fish to catch. A whole new experience, with more white fish powder than ever. A brand new adventure. Guns included.

More updates really soon. Wait and see.
LGV

notes.title: Update #1 - Fisherman Classic 1.1.0
Devlog #3
notes.notes:
[h1]ENGLISH[/h1]
Hi,
In this quick devlog, I would like to announce that every devlog, update or news will be written both in English and Portuguese. I wish I could translate everything also to Russian and Chinese, since these are two countries of the most Fisherman Classic's players. However, as a solo developer, I can only speak and write English and Portuguese. Maybe in the future, right?
[b]The June update will arrive with a game translation to portuguese as well!
[/b]
I'm also going to translate the last update (Monday) released to portuguese and release it on the store this friday, along with a "update visibility round", which will allow more visibility to the game. 

Now, regarding the game features itself, I'm currently developing a "bonus scene" for Fisherman Classic. I'm not going to spoil it right now, but it will be a arcade system heavily inspired on the "Jak & Dexter" fishing quest :D. More info about it this weekend!

[h1]PORTUGUÊS[/h1]
Olá,
Nesse devlog rápido, gostaria de anunciar que todo devlog, update ou qualquer notícia será postado em inglês e português. Gostaria de poder traduzir tudo para russo e chinês também, já que esses são os dois países com mais jogadores de Fisherman Classic. Porém, como sou um desenvolvedor "solo", só consigo traduzir para inglês e português. Quem sabe no futuro, né?
[b]O update de Junho contará com atualização do jogo para português!
[/b]
Também irei traduzir para português o conteúdo do último update (segunda-feira) e lançar nessa sexta, junto com um "update visibility round", que dará mais visibilidade para o jogo.

Agora, quanto ao conteúdo do jogo em si, estou desenvolvendo um "modo bonus" do Fisherman Classic. Não vou dar spoiler agora, mas será um pequeno jogo arcade fortemente inspirado na quest de pescaria do jogo "Jak & Dexter" :D. Mais informações sobre isso nesse fim de semana!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
In this quick Devlog I'd just like to announce that the new update is now available!
More details about the content added as well as bug fixes can be found on the specific post made previously. Check it out if possible. Feel free to comment on this post if you want to say anything!

The next big update will be released in June, but I'll be making small updates weekly based on the feedback and aiming at solving little issues or bugs. In this June update, I plan to double the size of the map, and to add more 20 species of fishes and sea creatures.

Regarding Linux, I had to remove the Linux version of the store page (but it is still part of the package) until I can fully fix the bugs that specific depot seem to have. This week I'm going to focus on this issue and I expect to fix it by next Monday.

Regarding the new quests and species, I'd like to emphasize that:
- The species that can be found in every fish spot (lake, sea, etc) are catalogued as LOW rarity;
- The species that can only be found in a single fish spot are catalogued as MEDIUM rarity;
- The Giant Squid, that also can be found in only one fish spot, but is much rare and hard to caught, is catalogued as HIGH rarity.
Keep in mind that, because the rarity will be important later on the game.
The two new quests were made towards exploring the whole map. Caughting the Giant Squid and, later, all 10 species will be a hard but rewarding task to do.


Again, thank you all! See you on the next weekly devlog.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Ahoy!
[/h1]
I had to create another event due to some problems, but here we go:

The first weekend of Fisherman Classic has passed, and a lot of people are playing it!
I'm aware of some bugs people are encountering, and because of that, we've decide to release a update next Monday already, and not only with bug fixes, but with new content!

The content we plan to release is:
[h2]
[/h2]- Missing sound effects (boat riding, fish and item caught, quest completed, fishing rod);
- Minor design update;
- A brand new quest;
- Three new species of fish;
- Bug fixes.

I've been receiving a lot of feedback, mostly through forums, and some of them here on the reviews section. Thank you all! I'm sure Fisherman Classic will grow a lot in this Early Access period.

Thank you!
